document_summary: A Managed IT Services proposal from Fortress IT Group for the client Whitfield & Associates, recommending the Standard support tier at 42 seats across two offices, with a full auditable monthly pricing breakdown (base rate, volume adjustment, seat subtotal, extra managed devices, Ohio tax, total recurring), a one-time onboarding fee, an included-scope bullet list, and next steps. It is being converted into a reusable template.

variables.sample_text: You noted Whitfield & Associates has grown to 42 employees across two offices with no dedicated IT support in place. At that headcount, informal or single-contractor IT support is statistically where firms start seeing recurring downtime, delayed patching, and no documented backup posture — all of which compound quietly until an outage or incident forces the issue. The scope below is sized specifically to your headcount and device footprint.
variables.description: Client-specific opening paragraph describing their current environment, headcount, locations and pain points, tying the scope to their size.

paragraph_config.purpose: Describe the prospect's current IT environment (headcount, locations, existing support) and why this scoped proposal fits it.

variables.sample_text: Standard is built for firms your size that need faster-than-business-hours coverage and managed backups, without paying for the 24/7 / vCIO layer that Premium adds — appropriate once you're running compliance-sensitive client data with real recovery-time expectations.
variables.description: Paragraph explaining why the recommended tier fits this client and what the next tier up would add.

paragraph_config.purpose: Justify the recommended support tier for the client's size and needs, and contrast briefly with the next tier up.

variables.sample_text: Minimum billable commitment is 10 seats — your 42-seat count is well above the floor, so no minimum-commit adjustment applies.
variables.description: Footnote below the pricing table stating the minimum seat commitment and confirming whether it affects this client.

paragraph_config.purpose: State the minimum billable seat commitment and confirm whether the client's seat count is above or below it.
